title: Halo CE enemies (standalone version)
load: HaloCE_Standalone_Covenant.pk3 on its own, with any other mods (it carries Core, the Covenant and their dialogue); add HaloCE_Standalone_Flood / HaloCE_Standalone_Sentinels / HaloCE_Standalone_Marines.pk3 after it, or load HaloCE_Standalone_Merged.pk3 for everything.
